scope: Four workload wrappers. Shared foundation dependencies are documented separately by its owner.
sourceVerification: Parameters and nested-module schemas inspected at the exact upstream release tags below; compilation uses their version-pinned br/public OCI artifacts. No moving main branch is used.
resourceOwnership: Every Azure resource is declared by upstream AVM. First-party wrappers contain only parameters, variables, AVM module calls and non-secret resource-ID/name outputs.
apiInventoryScope: APIs observed in pinned upstream source. Optional AVM features may include additional nested APIs even when disabled; presence in a compiled artifact does not prove deployment.

notes: Blob diagnostics, retention and private endpoint are native module inputs.
Upstream storage module declares secure access-key/connection-string outputs. Wrapper never references or re-exports them; Shared Key authorization is disabled.
The optional upstream public-IP module is disabled because no pipConfiguration is supplied.

The VM AVM has no top-level diagnosticSettings input. Native NIC AllMetrics diagnostics target the provided workspace; boot diagnostics are managed separately. Guest logs/guest performance are not configured and must not be claimed.

The upstream publicNetworkAccess/networkAccessPolicy parameters govern AVM-managed data disks, not the implicit VM OS disk. No data disks are created by this wrapper; do not claim these parameters disable OS disk export.
NODE|24-lts is an Azure-managed patch channel, not an exact Node executable pin.
Inbound Private Link and outbound VNet integration use separate platform-owned subnets.
Integrated privateEndpoints input targets the managedEnvironments group; not an internal-only environment.
azure-monitor log destination avoids workspace shared-key reads; diagnostics provide the workspace binding.
Container image digest and port are compile-time values from catalog/platform.json; not developer inputs.
External app ingress permits private callers outside the environment while environment public network access stays disabled.

previewApis.reason: Pinned upstream AVM diagnostic-setting implementations use this API. Accepted only as the explicitly documented demo exception; do not silently substitute a moving API.
